reviewer_role: Non-author of production project expansion, native adjacency, relation grammar, SourceOperatingSession dependencies and ROOT closure. Reviewer owns independent scope control tests and this report only.
scope: Real public selector citation closure over synthetic source IR, shared relation semantics, exact native carrier projection, typed/header/note legacy invariants, original-envelope budget and caller pipeline purity.

findings.issue: Mixed successful validation and later genuinely missing production certification lost the later restriction.
findings.fix: Shared connector/object binder preserves the source object for truly elided later predicates; positive validation and negative/not-yet approval remain separate.

findings.issue: Another device belonging to the original devices supplier was falsely bound to the issuer device.
findings.fix: Shared source attribution identifies the actual third-party possessive object; dependency requires actual object_refs intersection instead of broad assertion cooccurrence.

findings.issue: A denied nominalised proposition became an asserted restriction.
findings.fix: Shared relation owner marks predicate-local reported proposition scope unknown/uncertain, keeping original exact refs.

findings.issue: A competitors reported claim explicitly rejected by the company became a restriction.
findings.fix: Same shared proposition-scope owner, no company-specific denial scanner or cross-sentence inversion.

findings.issue: Only the first same-object restriction reached its earlier subject; a bare final deictic could survive a smaller selection budget.
findings.fix: Identity only continues an already proven issuer object; ROOT restores reciprocal context and one transitive component with actual budget costs.

findings.issue: Several original qualifiers compressed into a carrier were rejected by whole-carrier pronoun count, erasing original identity edges and the eight-original-unit bound.
findings.fix: Observe actual edge endpoint original text and map its observed native_range offsets into the material relation-ref namespace; internal carrier edges still propagate proved original identity.

findings.issue: Pairwise admissible physical neighbours do not by themselves prove the complete transitive original envelope.
findings.fix: Independent public tests isolate original units>8 at4blocks/122chars, blocks>4, and full chars>2048 with each pair<2048 at exactly4blocks. Whole component is deferred, never shortened into trusted prefixes.

findings.issue: A local component could repeatedly expand its material fanout after the shared work budget was exhausted.
findings.fix: ROOT checks existing exhausted state and debits member/component fanout before material-set construction. Code-reviewed on final bytes; existing shared-budget/partial controls remain green. No performance claim inferred from wall time.

findings.issue: An intermediate ROOT quality collector unconditionally added an empty private field to caller pipeline and broke13 old purity controls.
findings.fix: Transient numeric shape result uses the existing call-local _session_state. Old pipeline equality assertions remain unchanged; all13 former failures now pass.

architecture: Plain project prose uses each actual source member through shared native continuity and source operating session; a project title does not gate all body eligibility.
Affirmative original typed row/header/note dependencies retain atomic table/project semantics; table-purpose filtering and original context tests pass.
Native adjacency is physical source proof only (semantic_status not_evaluated), carries actual IDs and scope, and cannot assert event meaning.

Shared product-head grammar, relation object/actor/predicate/qualifier refs and bounded native offset mapping supply identity/state. No duplicate device vocabulary, guessed row/period, company ID or known-number branch was added.

ROOT applies the same existing graph budget and transitive original envelope including headings and expanded native members. Unknown or over-envelope cases are deferred; generic future paragraphs and other parent/project/section scopes are not attached.
Cache decision inventory binds actual relation/product-reference/native-continuity/narrative-reading bytes. No new persistent task store, cache, permission, approval receipt or API was introduced.
write_scope: Only test_reading_qualification_scope_controls.py and own resume/project-qualification-independent reports. No production, original/config/catalog, Git/index or external W09/W11 harness writes.
limitations: Synthetic in-memory source observations are openly labelled; no original annual document was re-read for this review.

This accepts a finite engineering root-cause node only. It does not accept annual14 content completeness, chemistry ancestry, table/source coverage, formal paid summaries, cache restore/public RF consumption, or the whole W08/RF audit loop.
Previously sealed real-source FAIL/PARTIAL outcomes remain historical evidence. ROOT must bind real replays and subsequent summaries to its actual final version.
